verdict.rationale: First-party docs say self-hosted Skyvern runs entirely on your own infrastructure (your servers, browsers and LLM keys), installable via pip, Docker Compose or Kubernetes, with a local-model option. The open-source positioning and a community note that it is AGPL3-licensed corroborate that the core is available to self-host. missing for 10: independent hands-on report of a self-hosted deployment, and evidence of feature parity between self-hosted and cloud (e.g., CAPTCHA solving, proxies, Copilot).
